projects.title: Dynamic Dashboard Builder
projects.short: A configurable analytics workspace for turning imported data into useful KPIs, charts, and custom views.
projects.summary: Turn raw data into a workspace that answers real questions.
projects.problem: People often have useful data trapped in CSV files and spreadsheets, but turning it into a clear dashboard takes too much manual work or specialist tooling.
projects.approach: Design a flexible dashboard canvas where imported data can become KPI cards, charts, tables, and filters. Keep the interaction model discoverable and make the workspace feel fast even when the user is experimenting.
features: Compose KPI cards, charts, and tables
Arrange widgets in a configurable grid

decisions.title: Data-first widgets
decisions.text: Keep source data separate from visual components so the same dataset can power multiple views.

decisions.title: Progressive configuration
decisions.text: Expose common settings first and keep advanced options out of the way until needed.

decisions.title: Responsive canvas
decisions.text: Allow the dashboard to collapse gracefully instead of forcing a desktop-only grid.

projects.outcome: The concept explores a reusable pattern for lightweight, self-serve analytics. Add measured results and a live demo here when the implementation is ready.

projects.title: School Management Platform
projects.short: A multi-tenant school operations concept spanning student records, attendance, staff, and administration.
projects.summary: One configurable platform for the daily work of a school.
projects.problem: Small and medium private schools need dependable workflows, but large all-in-one systems can be expensive, difficult to configure, or poorly matched to each school's operations.
projects.approach: Plan a modular school management system with tenant isolation, role-based access, reusable UI, and a focused MVP. Start with the operational workflows that schools use every day before expanding into advanced modules.

decisions.title: Tenant isolation
decisions.text: Keep each school's operational data separated and define provisioning and access boundaries early.

decisions.title: Modular MVP
decisions.text: Deliver the core school workflows first rather than launching a wide but shallow feature set.

decisions.title: Config-driven UI
decisions.text: Reuse components while allowing each tenant's roles, navigation, and settings to vary.

projects.outcome: A product direction and MVP architecture intended for validation with private K–12 schools. Validate the workflow priorities and pricing with school administrators before implementation expands.

projects.title: Job Discovery Platform
projects.short: A focused job aggregation experience with filters, saved profiles, resume uploads, and external apply flows.
projects.summary: Make relevant opportunities easier to discover and act on.
projects.problem: Job seekers have to jump between sources, repeat searches, and manage applications across disconnected sites. A focused discovery portal can reduce that friction without trying to own the employer's application process.
projects.approach: Build a responsive job portal with daily ingestion from permitted sources, clear filtering, private profiles, secure resume uploads, and outbound apply links. Keep analytics lightweight and avoid storing unnecessary sensitive information.
features: Daily job ingestion from permitted sources
Search and filter across job attributes
Redirect to the original application site

decisions.title: External application flow
decisions.text: Send users to the original job site rather than creating a duplicate application process.

decisions.title: Privacy by default
decisions.text: Keep profiles private and restrict resume access to authorized workflows.

decisions.title: Simple analytics
decisions.text: Use Firebase Analytics for product usage insights rather than building a separate analytics database.

projects.outcome: The build is organized around a clear, maintainable MVP. Add ingestion coverage, response-time measurements, and user feedback after testing with real users.

projects.title: Video Clipper
projects.short: A local-first creator tool concept for trimming footage, captions, aspect ratios, and social-ready exports.
projects.summary: A more direct path from long video to a shareable short clip.
projects.problem: Creating short-form clips often involves switching between several tools just to trim footage, reframe it, add captions, and prepare exports for different platforms.
projects.approach: Explore a timeline-led interface that makes the editing flow visible: choose a source, mark a range, adjust framing, style captions, add audio, and export a clip. Use a local processing approach where feasible.

decisions.title: Timeline as the anchor
decisions.text: Keep trim boundaries and clip duration visible so editing feels precise rather than modal-heavy.

decisions.title: Preview-first controls
decisions.text: Let users see framing and captions update before committing to an export.

decisions.title: Local-first direction
decisions.text: Explore local processing to reduce uploads and give users more control over their media.

projects.outcome: An interaction concept for a creator-focused editing workflow. Browser restrictions and source-video rights need to be handled explicitly in any production version.
